panels.title: 1. What DCGM tells you (and what it cannot)
GPU memory used per pod (framebuffer) · DCGM
panels.description: Flat from minute one: vLLM pre-allocates --gpu-memory-utilization of the card. This counter cannot tell you which pod is in trouble.

panels.title: GPU utilization % (coarse) · DCGM
panels.description: Any kernel active in the sample window counts as busy. Pegs near 100% for both pods under load regardless of how much work is actually done.

panels.title: SM active ratio (real compute occupancy) · DCGM
panels.description: DCGM_FI_PROF_SM_ACTIVE: fraction of streaming multiprocessors doing work. The honest compute signal.

panels.title: 2. What the serving log knows (Fluent Bit + Lua -> log_to_metrics)
KV cache usage % per pod · parsed from vLLM log line
panels.description: The real 'GPU full' signal for an LLM server. vllm_log_kv_cache_usage_pct is a gauge emitted by Fluent Bit log_to_metrics from the 'GPU KV cache usage: NN%' field.

panels.title: Waiting, running and preemptions per pod · parsed from vLLM log line
panels.description: Waiting > 0 means the scheduler has no KV blocks left to admit requests; preemptions means it started evicting running ones. Latency rises here before any GPU counter moves.

panels.title: Generation throughput (tokens/s) per pod · parsed from vLLM log line
3. Cross-check: native vLLM /metrics (vLLM exposes these itself; many servers do not)
Request queue time p95 · vLLM /metrics
panels.description: histogram_quantile over vllm:request_queue_time_seconds. The EARLIEST saturation signal: queue time rises before 'waiting' is visibly non-zero (Elastic, 2025). Queue time first, waiting confirms.

panels.title: KV cache usage % and requests waiting · vLLM /metrics
panels.description: Same numbers as row 2, scraped from vLLM's own Prometheus endpoint. They should agree. If your server does not expose them, row 2 is how you get them anyway.

panels.title: 4. Traces (join on the same pod name)

options.content: Spans carry `k8s.pod.name` (OTel k8sattributes). Open Jaeger, filter service `vllm-constrained`, sort by duration: the slow spans sit exactly where row 2 shows KV cache at 100% and waiting > 0 for the same pod, while row 1 shows nothing new.
